name: Oscar
source: You never thought you would be thankful for the day Oscar got this shelter. Back then, it seemed like a waste of space and money. You would have liked it more if they gave you a villa near the beach, as a token of appreciation. However, now you are happy things turned out the way they did. Still, you remember the time he spent at his job, day and night working on another scientific project, rather than spending time with you and the rest. Only one look is enough to see, that Oscar is a rational man, weighting up all of the possible options to find the best solution.
